description: LE-19: an arithmetic runtime error names the site that FAILED, not the site that emitted the shared out-lined numeric-tower helper. `*` has three live sites here; the first is inside `scale` (line 20), which returns successfully twice, and the failing site is line 28. Before the fix every arithmetic type error in a module was reported at the first site — here input.esk:20:6, a working expression — because the out-lined `__eshkol_arith_mul` (ESH-0103) baked a compile-time constant location into its error branches. The span now travels as call-site arguments. `forbidden`/`run_stderr_forbidden` also pin that this program still compiles cleanly and that the failure is a diagnosed error rather than a signal.

runtime_diagnostics.contains: Type error in tensor-mul: expected tensor, got integer
